tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) URL and return clean Markdown of the main page content. Strips navigation, ads, scripts and footers. Does not run JavaScript, so client-side-only pages may come back thin or empty. Respects robots.txt. Invalid, blocked, or failed reads are not charged. Costs $0.001 USDC via x4

tools.name: extract_page
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) HTML page and return structured JSON: title, meta and Open Graph tags, JSON-LD, headings, links, emails, images, and tables. Does not run JavaScript. Respects robots.txt. Failed or invalid fetches are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402. Failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: pdf_text
tools.description: Extract embedded text from a public PDF URL or a base64 PDF body. No OCR, so scanned or image-only pages may come back empty. Respects robots.txt. Max 5 MB and the first 50 pages. Failed or unreadable files are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402. Failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Fetch a public RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed URL and return title, link, dates, and summaries for the latest items. Does not render HTML or follow every item link. Respects robots.txt. Failed fetches are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402. Failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Fetch a public sitemap.xml or HTML page and return the listed URLs. Sitemap indexes are listed, not crawled. HTML extraction uses <a href> and <link> tags only and does not run JavaScript. Respects robots.txt. Failed fetches are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402. Failed calls are not charged.

tools.description: Look up a public domain: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA) via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS, public RDAP registration data, and an HTTPS/TLS probe. tools.description: Convert an amount between fiat currencies using the latest European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates. tools.name: csv_json
tools.description: Convert CSV text to JSON records, or an array of objects/arrays to CSV. Delimiter is auto-detected for CSV input (comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe). Local compute. Oversized or invalid input is not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402. Failed calls are not charged.

Heuristic only, not a human judgment of quality. Local compute. Oversized input is not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC via x402

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, extract_page, read_feed, extract_links, http_headers · Private data: pdf_text, domain_lookup, csv_json, evm_decode · Public sink: cron_next · Destructive: read_url, extract_page, extract_links, image_meta, http_headers, cron_next.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, extract_page, read_feed, extract_links, http_headers · Private data: pdf_text, domain_lookup, csv_json, evm_decode · Public sink: cron_next · Destructive: read_url, extract_page, extract_links, image_meta, http_headers, cron_next

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
